verdict.rationale: Fin has documented programmatic API guides on developers.intercom.com, including the Fin Agent API and its Preview orchestration endpoints. The official TypeScript SDK README shows code examples. Nothing shows an interactive reference or in-browser runnable examples, and the probes found no OpenAPI spec at fin.ai. Missing for 10: an interactive API explorer or try-it console, runnable examples, a published OpenAPI spec, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
